description.zh: 把项目周报/日报 Excel 汇总成可查询、可对比、可分享的任务台账。负责建表、批量导入、校验失败行，并按周期汇总风险与延期。
description.en: Turns project weekly/daily report spreadsheets into a searchable, comparable, shareable task ledger. Builds the app, imports batches, validates failed rows, and summarizes risks and delays by period.

welcome_message.zh: 把本周项目周报的 Excel 放到 reports/，我来建台账并导入。也可以先点「初始化台账」。
welcome_message.en: Put this week's project report Excel files in reports/ and I will build the ledger and import them. Or start with “Set up the ledger”.

description.zh: 创建项目报告台账应用，准备导入目录
description.en: Create the project report ledger app and prepare the import folder

prompt.zh: 请读取 `skills/pm-report-init/SKILL.md`，按步骤初始化「项目报告台账」。如果当前 Agent 已经有这个应用，直接打开它并告诉我当前状态，不要重复创建。
prompt.en: Read `skills/pm-report-init/SKILL.md` and set up the Project Reports ledger. If this agent already has the app, open it and report its state instead of creating a duplicate.

description.zh: 扫描周报目录，先预检再入库
description.en: Scan report files, preview, then import

prompt.zh: 请读取 `skills/pm-report-ingest/SKILL.md`，扫描 `reports/` 和 `inbound/` 里新增的项目周报 Excel，先 dry-run 汇总，再导入「项目报告台账」。导入完成后告诉我新增、更新、失败和跳过的行数。
prompt.en: Read `skills/pm-report-ingest/SKILL.md`, scan `reports/` and `inbound/` for new project report Excel files, summarize a dry run, then import into the Project Reports ledger. Report added, updated, failed and skipped rows.

description.zh: 汇总延期、阻塞和需要决策的事项

prompt.zh: 请读取 `skills/pm-report-review/SKILL.md`，汇总最新报告期的延期、阻塞和高优先级任务，按项目分组，给出需要负责人决策的事项。不要编造数据。
prompt.en: Read `skills/pm-report-review/SKILL.md`, summarize delayed, blocked and high-priority tasks for the latest period by project, and list decisions the owners need to make. Do not invent data.

description.zh: 保留新年份，导出并清理旧报告期
description.en: Keep the new year, export and trim older periods

prompt.zh: 请读取 `skills/pm-report-archive/SKILL.md`，先问我保留从哪个报告期开始，然后指导我从应用详情页导出主表 CSV 和应用备份，再运行归档脚本。清理活动表前必须让我二次确认。
prompt.en: Read `skills/pm-report-archive/SKILL.md`, ask which period to keep, guide me to export the main-table CSV and a backup from the app detail page, then run the archive script. Ask for a second confirmation before trimming the live table.

zh: 每周五「17:00」扫描 reports/ 里本周的项目周报，导入台账并列出失败行
每周一「09:00」汇总上周延期和阻塞任务，按项目给出负责人待办
每月最后一个工作日「16:00」对比本月与上月各项目的完成率和延期数
收到新的项目周报 Excel 后，先预检字段，再导入并告诉我更新了哪些任务
检查历史报告里哪些项目连续两周出现延期任务
把某个项目最近 8 周的任务轨迹整理成一页复盘摘要
en: Every Friday at 17:00, scan reports/ for this week's project reports, import them and list failed rows
Every Monday at 09:00, summarize last week's delayed and blocked tasks by project with owner actions
On the last business day of each month at 16:00, compare completion rate and delay counts by project with the previous month
When a new project report Excel arrives, preview the fields first, then import and report which tasks changed
Find projects that had delayed tasks for two consecutive weeks in the report history
Turn the last 8 weeks of one project's task timeline into a one-page review
